label: coach_teacher_head_first_00
text: Do forgive the intrusion.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_first_01
text: Director Clavell of Naranja Academy, at your\nservice.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_first_01b
text: Director Clavell of Uva Academy, at your service.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_00
text: I’ve heard all about your adventures here from\nDirector Cyrano.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_01
text: As I understand it, you’ve already battled your\nway to the top of the League Club and played a\r\nmajor role in an out-of-school expedition.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_02
text: As your director, I could not be more proud.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_03
text: But still, I should like to hear your thoughts. How\nhas life at Blueberry Academy been treating you?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_select_01
text: It’s so much fun!

label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_select_02
text: It’s, er...well...

label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_04
text: That warms my heart to hear. I’m so glad you\nwere able to come here to study.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_04b
text: Ah. Is something here troubling you, perhaps?\c\nDo remember that you can return to Paldea\nwhenever you feel the need.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_05
text: I’ll be staying here for a while as a special coach,\nso feel free to come and chat anytime.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_00
text: Well met, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)].\c\nI wanted to ask...has anything in particular been\nwearing you down here at Blueberry Academy?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_01
text: For instance...Director Cyrano. Has he been\nbothering you with his unreasonable requests?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_select_01
text: I’ve been totally fine!

label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_select_02
text: The director’s a nice guy!

label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_02
text: I see... Well, that’s reassuring.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_03
text: You know, Director Cyrano and I studied together\nat the same university, oh, a long time ago now.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_04
text: Right from the start I found myself rather at the\nmercy of his whims.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_05
text: This state of affairs continued even once I had\nbeen appointed as director of our academy...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_06
text: He said to me, “Velly, you need a dash more\ndignity about you. A lofty air! Try wearing some\r\nPremier Balls at your waist—that’ll do it!”[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_07
text: Well, I suppose it’s my own fault for going along\nwith these ideas of his...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_08
text: In any case, please don’t hesitate to contact me\nif you need any help.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_00
text: I wanted to talk to you about your exchange\nstudies, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_01
text: Thanks to your presence here at Blueberry\nAcademy, I’ve been able to visit more often.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_02
text: Observing other schools firsthand can be\ninstructive in all sorts of ways, you know.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_03
text: Right now, I’m considering how we can adopt the\nbest aspects of this school at our own academy\r\nand would appreciate your input on the matter.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_04
text: So. What is it that you like best about Blueberry\nAcademy, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_select_01
text: The values

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_select_02
text: The location

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_select_03
text: The facilities

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_select_04
text: The director

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_05
text:
Oho. Very interesting...\c
I see you must appreciate the autonomy given to
students here, as well as their vigorous appetite
for Pokémon battles.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_05b
text:
Oho. Very interesting...\c
It’s certainly true that an academy floating upon
the sea makes for a stunning sight.\c
But applying this to our own academy would
mean uprooting the entire building...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_05c
text:
Oho. Very interesting...\c
It’s certainly true that the Terarium is ideal for
observing Pokémon in their natural habitats.\c
Of course, I do not believe that Paldea’s own
rich nature can be found wanting in that regard...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_05d
text:
I-I beg your pardon?!\c
Director Cyrano certainly is a remarkable man,
but if he were to become our academy director,
that would mean I’d get the boot, so to speak...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_06
text: Well, in any case, duly noted. Thank you very\nmuch for sharing your thoughts.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_trade_01_00
text:
Talking with you like this reminds me of your very
first day as one of my students.\c
That was the day I gave you your first partner
Pokémon—[VAR 0x0101(0002)].[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_trade_01_01
text: I believe you’ve found many treasures of your\nown since then.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_trade_01_02
text: Would you consider sharing one of those with\nme...in the form of a Pokémon trade?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_trade_01_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Much obliged. In that case, I shall offer you a
Pawmo from my side.\c
What Pokémon will you choose, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_trade_01_04
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Thank you very much for trading me your\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)].\c\nI will treasure it and raise it with all due care.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_trade_02_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So you would like to trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)]
for
my
Pawmo?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_trade_02_01
text: You can’t trade Director Clavell a Pokémon if you\naren’t its original Trainer!

label: coach_teacher_head_trade_02_02
text: You can’t trade Director Clavell such a rare\nPokémon!

label: coach_teacher_head_trade_02_03
text: You can’t trade Director Clavell a Shiny Pokémon!

label: coach_teacher_head_trade_03_00
text:
Oh, but gracious me! I see you only have one
Pokémon in your party at present.\c
Do come and see me again once you have at
least two Pokémon with you. Then we shall trade.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_trade_03_01
text: Do take some time to think about it. I’ll be here\nwhen you have reached a decision.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_trade_04_00
text: Would you be willing to share one of your\ntreasures with me through a Pokémon trade?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_talkto_00
text: Oh? Would you like to challenge me to a battle,\nM[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_cancel_00
text: If you need someone to talk to, I am always at\nyour disposal.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_battlestart_00
text: Well then, I humbly accept. Not as your director,\nmind you, but as a fellow Pokémon Trainer![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01
text: [EMPTY 66]

label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_win_00_00
text: The Pokémon you have raised certainly are\ntreasures of inestimable value.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_win_00_01
text: ...Ah! But how very careless of me. I almost forgot\nthat I have something to give you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_win_00_02
text: A good friend of mine wanted you to have this\nas a token of his thanks.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_win_00_03
text: It’s a rather trendy item of headwear, you know.\nWhy, I’m almost tempted to procure one myself![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_reward_00
text: You received a [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Clive Wig [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from Director Clavell!

label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_win_01_00
text: What a superb battle. I feel we both deserve a\nhearty pat on the back for our efforts.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_win_01_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Do make sure that [VAR 0x0101(0002)] gets plenty
of
rest,
now.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_lose_00_00
text:
What a fiery battle that was! I may have emerged
as victor, but it could have fallen either way.\c
The key is in how we choose to handle defeat...
but I believe you know this well enough already.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_randomtalk_00
text:
Sprigatito, Fuecoco, and Quaxly are all rather
easy to care for and raise.\c
That’s why we chose those three as the partner
Pokémon to be given to students who enroll in
our academy.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_randomtalk_01
text:
I purposefully gave no firm deadline for students
to complete their Treasure Hunt.\c
Feel free to continue pursuing your adventures
wherever your heart takes you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_randomtalk_02
text:
If you’re looking for Director Cyrano, I believe I
saw him over by the academy’s entrance.\c
I do hope he’s paying due attention to the
academy’s administrative affairs and not just
lounging about all day...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_randomtalk_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]The [VAR 0x0101(0001)] you kindly traded me is
very
good
company.\c
Why, it refuses to even leave my side![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: coach_teacher_head_randomtalk_04
text: Is the Pawmo I traded you doing well?\c\nI caught him during my return trip on that day\nI visited your home, you know.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
